title: Is it the weekend?
hints: Compare `isWeekend("sunday")` with `isWeekend("Sunday")`. Only the capital letter is different.
`===` compares strings letter by letter, and `"S"` is not the same letter as `"s"`. The function compares the day exactly as it was typed.
Make the input lowercase before comparing: `const lower = day.toLowerCase();` and compare `lower` instead of `day`.
